</details>

**The pull request description is still unanswered.** No new conversation is opened for it: a thread from an earlier review already carries this note, or this review could not rule one out. The finding stands until the description answers.

The Context section's handoff paragraph still says "Not live-tested: ... the only `next` install reachable from here (a2a-next-dev) is read-only for this session and declares no sidecar, so it would render exactly what it renders today", while the Live validation section describes rolling a branch-built operator image onto that same install, patching a sidecar in, and observing the refused Job, the `Ready=False` status, the revert and the restore. Both cannot be true of this head; a reader who stops at Context takes the change as unexercised, and one who reads on cannot tell which paragraph is current. Drop or rewrite the stale "Not live-tested" sentence so the description says once whether and how the change was run.

_This was a strict pass: what I am certain of, plus any high-severity finding just under that bar, marked as such. Comment `/review all` to see the checked-but-not-certain findings too._
